evidence.conclusion: Explicit shared index, coefficient copy, cumulative mass, positive-root inversion, and tE assignment.
24 finite a,b,time,flow records in the exact consumed order.
Ten-vial masses are assigned in condition-major, replicate-minor order.

clock_origin.conclusion: Mass fit time is rebased to its selected first sample; its zero-intercept polynomial is used directly for tE.

massdata_to_run_tE.conclusion: run.tE is the positive-root inversion of cumulative ten-vial mE using copied MassData a and b.

massdata_to_shot_order.conclusion: Released preprocessing traverses eight conditions and three physical runs and indexes MassData as i*3-3+j.

vial_transition.conclusion: Boundaries are cumulative measured vial masses; source supplies ten ordered collection intervals.
